results.question: Engineering departments
results.answer: EGSPEC reports 11 undergraduate programs. The official Bachelor's page lists: Mechanical Engineering; Artificial Intelligence and Data Science; Civil Engineering; Electrical and Electronics Engineering; Electronics and Communication Engineering; Computer Science and Engineering; Information Technology; Biomedical Engineering; Computer Science and Business Systems; Cyber Security; and Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. The Master's page names six engineering specializations: Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Power Electronics and Drives, Communication Systems, and Environmental Engineering. The website also has postgraduate departments for MBA and MCA. The official history page reports 9 PG programs in total.

results.question: Which courses are NBA accredited and what is their scope?
results.answer: The official EGSPEC accreditation page currently lists eight NBA-accredited programs. Valid up to 30 June 2028: B.E. Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), B.Tech. Information Technology (IT), and B.E. Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE). Valid up to 30 June 2027: B.E. Mechanical Engineering, B.E. Civil Engineering, and B.E. Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE). Valid up to 31 December 2028: B.E. Biomedical Engineering (BME) and the postgraduate MCA program. Typical career scope: CSE—software engineering, AI/data, cloud and cybersecurity; IT—application development, cloud, networks and information security; ECE—embedded systems, VLSI, communication, electronics and IoT; Mechanical—design, manufacturing, automotive, robotics and energy; Civil—construction, structural engineering, infrastructure, surveying and environmental work; EEE—power systems, renewable energy, industrial automation, control systems and electric vehicles; BME—medical devices, clinical engineering, healthcare technology and biomedical research; MCA—software/application development, data systems, cloud and IT consulting. NBA accredits the specific program, not every program in the institution, and accreditation does not by itself guarantee a placement.

results.question: Pharmacy courses enna?
results.answer: The official Pharmacy site lists D.Pharm (2 years, intake 60), B.Pharm (4 years, intake 100; 3-year lateral entry after D.Pharm), Pharm.D (6 years, intake 30), and M.Pharm (2 years) with Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Analysis, and Pharmacology branches. Typical scope includes community and hospital pharmacy, pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality assurance and control, regulatory affairs, clinical pharmacy, pharmacovigilance, research, and higher studies. Eligibility varies by course and must be checked against the current admission notification.

results.question: Polytechnic branches
results.answer: The official Polytechnic site lists 3-year Diploma programs. Government-aided courses include Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Engineering, and Instrumentation and Control Engineering. Self-financing courses include Electrical and Electronics Engineering and Mechanical Engineering. First-year Basic Engineering is common, followed by the allotted branch across six semesters. The college was established in 2006, is affiliated to DOTE Tamil Nadu, and highlights workshops, laboratories, placement support, and lateral-entry options to B.E.
